verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for a cloud communications API like Twilio Video, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers rooms, status callbacks, SDKs, pricing and recording, but never mentions API keys, access tokens, credential scoping or least-privilege permissions. With no evidence for this capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
